## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 because invasive carcinoma leads the prediction and is the sole conformal class [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Dominant score; dataset ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at alpha 0.10 (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 94th OOD percentile [F6] | Unflagged; all 12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (77%–83% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical embedding score (+1.36, contribution +1.59); 19/20 AI spot-checked [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · High score (+2.50, contribution +1.30), but 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.53, contribution +1.06); caption inconsistent; 18/20 spot-checked [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.02, contribution +0.91); 20/20 AI spot-checked · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.75, contribution +0.72); 18/20 AI spot-checked · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Image sits at the 94th OOD percentile with failed HoVer-Net cell segmentation and uniform region risk (0.999–1.0).
- Benign mimic `BACH_0030` (66% similarity) is mistaken for stromal invasion and pleomorphism; test set has only 24 patients.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4**: Verify true stromal invasion before approving drafted ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 stain orders.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 3, 4**: Confirm nuclear pleomorphism (2, 3, 4) and manually count mitoses (1, 2, 4; concept unreliable).
3. **Regions 10, 11**: Check loss of tubules (11) and benign stroma (10) against benign contrast case `BACH_0030`.
